name: FinSaathi - AI Agent for Digital Financial Literacy
description: An AI-powered Digital Financial Literacy Agent for Indian users, powered by IBM Granite (RAG). Helps users understand UPI, avoid online scams, understand interest rates, budgeting, government schemes, and personal finance — in 12 Indian languages.
problem_statement: IBM Problem Statement #7 — AI Agent for Digital Financial Literacy

technology_stack.frontend: Vanilla HTML5 / CSS3 / JavaScript (single-page dark-theme chat UI)
technology_stack.cloud_platform: IBM Cloud Lite + IBM watsonx.ai Studio

ibm_services.mandatory_service: IBM Granite LLM via IBM watsonx.ai

features: RAG-powered financial Q&A with source attribution
12 Indian language support (Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Bengali, Marathi, Gujarati, Kannada, Punjabi, Malayalam, Odia, Urdu, English)
Fraud alert system — detects urgency/scam keywords and prepends immediate safety warnings
Topic chips for quick navigation (UPI, Fraud, Loans, Budget, Schemes, Investment)
12 curated knowledge base documents from RBI, NPCI, cybercrime.gov.in, SEBI, IRDAI, Ministry of Finance
Dark-theme chat UI with typing indicator and source pills
knowledge_base_categories: Government Schemes (Jan Dhan, MUDRA, APY, PMSBY, PMJJBY)

api_endpoints.POST /chat: Main RAG chat endpoint — accepts message + optional language code
api_endpoints.GET /health: Health check with IBM config status and document count
api_endpoints.GET /categories: Returns all topic categories for UI chips

setup.configure: cp .env.example .env  # then fill IBM_API_KEY and IBM_PROJECT_ID

env_vars_required.IBM_API_KEY: IBM Cloud API Key (from cloud.ibm.com → Manage → API Keys)

knowledge_sources: National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal — cybercrime.gov.in
Ministry of Finance — Jan Dhan Yojana, MUDRA
architecture: User Query → Language Detection → Translate to EN → e5 Embed → ChromaDB Retrieve → IBM Granite Generate → Translate Back → User
license: Submitted for IBM Problem Statement #7 — AI Agent for Digital Financial Literacy
